goal: Create an API key for the staging environment
why_human: The key is shown once and must never pass through the agent.

steps.text: Press Create API Key and name it staging-mailer.
Copy the key into .env.staging as RESEND_API_KEY.
steps.warning: The key is displayed only once.

steps.text: Open the webhook settings and copy the signing secret into config/secrets/staging.env as RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

verify: Check that RESEND_API_KEY exists in .env.staging without reading its value, then send a staging test email and confirm it is delivered.
